'''Garrok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Chief/Legends|chief]] who lived on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR:NW" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> he was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="TOR:CoT" /> whilst amongst the Tusken camps built in the [[Northern Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="TOR:NW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garrok appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Tatooine.<ref name="TOR:NW" /> He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.<ref name="TOR:CoT" />
